summary: Applied all available security updates on node1. DNF upgraded 114 packages and installed the updated kernel. After reboot, no security updates remain, required services are healthy, and the original inventory data is intact.
actions_performed: Applied DNF security updates from the configured RHEL BaseOS and AppStream repositories.
Verified the successful transaction and selected the updated kernel for boot.
Validated inventory JSON/CSV contents and matching pre/post SHA-256 fingerprints.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed recovery on kernel 6.12.0-211.50.1.el10_2.

evidence.summary: DNF history records a successful `upgrade --security` transaction; the final repository check reports no pending security updates.
The JSON and CSV remained valid and retained identical SHA-256 fingerprints and contents after updating and rebooting.

Captured a healthy pre-restart baseline, received restart acknowledgement, observed boot ID change from e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 to 0f2cad45-14c6-434c-b5e9-f05bb4c70686, and verified updated-kernel, service, and inventory recovery.
